verses.1: And the tabernacle will be made of twelve squares, each square measuring six cubits in length, width, and height. It will also have two curtains, each curtain being as thick as the other. All these parts will be carefully constructed according to precise measurements.
verses.2: The length of one of these wings is fifty feet, and its width is four feet. Each wing is divided into two equal parts.
verses.3: Five of these pieces will be connected to each other by a woman. And five more pieces will be connected to each other by a woman as well.
verses.4: And you shall make a handle on the edge of one of the leaves, from one side of the joint. Similarly, you shall do the same with the edge of the leaf at the joint of the second leaf.
verses.5: Thirty more units should be made on one side of the cloth. Thirty more units should also be made at the edge of the cloth, in the area where the second seam is located. These units should be connected to each other.
verses.6: And you made fifty golden frames, and you fastened the pieces together with nails. So, the structure became one whole unit.
verses.7: And you shall make twelve pieces of leather for the altar, on top of the sanctuary.
verses.8: The length of one of these triangles is thirty amahs, and its width is four amahs. One triangle can be divided into twelve triangles.
verses.9: And you measured five cubits for each side, and six cubits for each side. Then you divided the sixth cubit into two equal parts, and placed it opposite the entrance of the temple.
verses.10: And you made fifty doors on the mouth of the first tunnel in the neighborhood. And you also made fifty doors on the mouth of the second tunnel in the neighborhood.
verses.11: And you made fifty bronze pillars. You brought them into the Temple, and you assembled them together. They became one whole structure.
verses.12: And the wings of the eagle are spread out across the tent’s surfaces. Half of those wings cover the rest of the structure.
verses.13: And this area, and this area too, along the length of the tent’s walls, will be covered with sand. This area will be used as a covering for those parts of the tent.
verses.14: And you made a covering for the tent of the covenant, made of earth and mud. And you also made a covering for the altar, made of clay.
verses.15: And you made the beams for the house from cypress wood that stood upright.
verses.16: The length of the cross is twelve amotes. The width of each cross is one and a half amotes.
verses.17: Two hands are needed for lifting one of the beams. This is how it should be done for all the beams in the building.
verses.18: And you made the beams for the house. There were forty beams for each side of the roof.
verses.19: And forty silver basins shall be made under the twenty pillars. Two basins shall be under each pillar, one basin for each hand.
verses.20: And on the wall of the second house, there were forty columns.
verses.21: And forty of their branches were made of gold; two branches under one beam, and two branches under the other beam.
verses.22: And when I build the tent, I will make six poles for it.
verses.23: And two pillars shall be made for the foundations of the temple, in its corners.
verses.24: And they will be pure from the bottom up. Together, they will be pure on their heads, up to the same point as the other two points. Thus, they will become pure for both of them.
verses.25: And there were six columns, with their capitals made of gold. Two of the capitals were under one column, and two others were under the other column.
verses.26: And you made five wooden beams from their wood, to be used as the pillars of the one altar.
verses.27: And five of them went to the beams of the second pillar of the temple. And five of them went to the beams of the pillar that supported the doors.
verses.28: And the last bird flies within the cages; it flies from one end to the other.
verses.29: And the frames will be covered with gold, and their handles will also be made of gold. They will be decorated with gold decorations on their edges. I have seen these decorations, they’re indeed made of gold.
verses.30: And they set up the tent as it was commanded, according to what was written in the scriptures.
verses.31: And you made a wheel, a pulley, and a second pulley. And six springs were also made from this material. This is a cleverly crafted object.
verses.32: And it was placed upon four pillars made of gold and silver. There were also four golden handles on those pillars.
verses.33: And you shall place the basket under the cover. Then take it from the house to the basket, along with the offerings of worship. You shall separate the basket for yourself from the sacred items, and also distinguish between the sacred items and the non-sacred ones.
verses.34: And you laid the crown upon the head of the priest in the holiness of the holy ones.
verses.35: And you shall place the altar outside the door, and the lampstand shall be placed next to the altar, on the wall of the house. The altar shall also be placed on the wall of Tsafon.
verses.36: And you made a door for the entrance to the tabernacle. You made a frame, a framework, and two doors. There were also six posts used in the construction of this structure.
verses.37: And you made five pillars for the temple. You covered them with gold. They were all made of gold. And you poured five gallons of water into them.
